Here are some museums in the Netherlands dedicated to the Holocaust that you can explore:

1. **Jewish Historical Museum (Joods Historisch Museum)** – Amsterdam
   - Focuses on Jewish history and culture, including the Holocaust.
   - [Website](https://www.jhm.nl/en)

2. **Anne Frank House (Anne Frank Huis)** – Amsterdam
   - The hiding place where Anne Frank wrote her diary during WWII.
   - [Website](https://www.annefrank.org/en/)

3. **Dutch Resistance Museum (Verzetsmuseum)** – Amsterdam
   - Covers resistance efforts during WWII, including Jewish persecution.
   - [Website](https://www.verzetsmuseum.org/en)

4. **National Holocaust Memorial (Nationaal Holocaustmonument)** – Amsterdam
   - A memorial site honoring Dutch victims of the Holocaust.
   - [Website](https://www.nationaalholocaustmonument.nl/en)

5. **Camp Westerbork Memorial Centre (Herinneringscentrum Kamp Westerbork)** – Hooghalen
   - Former transit camp where Dutch Jews were deported to concentration camps.
   - [Website](https://kampwesterbork.nl/en/)

6. **Joods Museum in Synagogue (Joods Museum in Synagoge)** – Delft
   - Exhibits on Jewish history, including WWII.
   - [Website](https://www.joods-museum-delft.nl/)
